podcast.body: Bruce Springsteen's 1984 song is cited as an example of rock music referencing specific car models. "...Bruce Springsteen's Pink Cadillac in 1984..."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This 1984 B-side track received considerable airplay during the peak of Springsteen's *Born in the U.S.A.* fame and partly inspired the "pink Cadillac" lyric in Aretha Franklin's "Freeway of Love." "It's lyric about going riding in a pink Cadillac was inspired in part by Springsteen's much beloved 1984 track of the same name, a B side that received considerable airplay at the peak of Bruce's born in the USA fame."
